$comment: Coverage of the XCCDF 1.1.4 and 1.2 schemas by the benchmark path. Keys under paths are the XSD walker's prefix-free local-name paths (a key ending in /** covers the paths below it, never the path itself). Keys under vendor are paths the schemas leave opaque, extended with the publisher's own elements or narrowed with a [@attr=value] selector. target names where the value lands in the Baseline, or skip with a reason. Asserted by go/coverage_test.go and typescript/coverage.test.ts.

Benchmark/@Id.reason: the 1.2 XML Schema ID is a signature anchor, not an identifier the Baseline carries

Benchmark/@resolved.reason: resolution flag is not carried; the converter reads the file as published

Benchmark/Group.reason: walked as the Group root; each Group becomes a group and its rules requirements

Benchmark/Platform-Specification.reason: 1.1.4 platform definitions from imported namespaces are not carried

Benchmark/Profile.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: passthrough.profiles (id, title, selectedRuleIds); card lrgu7.16: tags.cis_level from profile membership

Benchmark/Profile/**.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: passthrough.profiles (id, title, selectedRuleIds); card lrgu7.16: tags.cis_level from profile membership

Benchmark/Rule.reason: walked as the Rule root; each Rule becomes a requirement
Benchmark/Rule.fixture: none: no benchmark fixture places a Rule directly under Benchmark; every one nests its rules in Groups

Benchmark/TestResult.reason: test results are the results path's input, converted by ConvertXccdfResultsToHDF; the benchmark path ignores them

Benchmark/TestResult/**.reason: test results are the results path's input, converted by ConvertXccdfResultsToHDF; the benchmark path ignores them

Benchmark/Value.reason: Value definitions are not carried; refine-value tailoring is not applied

Benchmark/Value/**.reason: Value definitions are not carried; refine-value tailoring is not applied

Benchmark/cpe-list.reason: 1.1.4 platform definitions from imported namespaces are not carried

Benchmark/dc-status.reason: Dublin Core status is not carried

Benchmark/dc-status/**.reason: Dublin Core status is not carried

Benchmark/description.reason: the element's own text, markup stripped; text inside xhtml children is not carried

Benchmark/description/**.reason: both parsers read only the element's own text, so text inside xhtml children is not carried; sub substitution, @override and xml:lang are not carried

Benchmark/notice.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: passthrough.notices (id, text)

Benchmark/notice/**.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: passthrough.notices (id, text)

Benchmark/plain-text.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: by @id, see the vendor selector rows

Benchmark/plain-text/@id.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: selects release-info, generator and conventionsVersion

Benchmark/platform-definitions.reason: 1.1.4 platform definitions from imported namespaces are not carried

Benchmark/platform-specification.reason: CPE 2 platform specifications are not carried

Benchmark/reference.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: passthrough.publisher and passthrough.source from dc:publisher and dc:source

Benchmark/reference/**.reason: skip until card lrgu7.13: passthrough.publisher and passthrough.source from dc:publisher and dc:source
